extras: A companion tool, vce2flashquiz, is available to convert VCE exam files into the plugin's Markdown format.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin for creating interactive, timed exams from your notes.
problem: Standard note-taking tools lack the functionality to transform static notes into interactive, timed, and structured computer-based tests.
summary: A plugin for creating interactive, timed computer-based tests directly within Obsidian using a specific Markdown syntax.
